Description: CoderHelm v0.8.5 (about 20 minutes). One stack holds the whole install: a permissions boundary every CoderHelm role carries, a private bucket with this release's files (each checked against the sha256 in this signed template), the install's secret, and the parts as nested stacks. No build job and no standing deploy role (unless you turn auto-update on). Update: a stack update to the next release's template. Uninstall: delete this stack (KeepDataOnDelete decides about the data). docs.coderhelm.com/self-host/security

Label.default: Filled in by the install guide or by CoderHelm (leave as they are)

CoderHelm.Description: Your CoderHelm. Sign up there with your email.

Domain.Description: Your domain's state (Settings, System has the details)

KeepDataOnDelete.Description: Whether deleting this stack keeps the data

SignUpUrl.Description: The first admin signs up here

Version.Description: The CoderHelm release this stack runs

AdminEmail.Description: You become the first admin. Sign up with this address when the stack is complete.

AutoUpdate.Description: off (the default): CoderHelm prepares each new release as a change set for you to review and execute. on: adds a CloudFormation service role (coderhelm-<name>-deploy) that applies releases in the maintenance window (docs/self-host/security.md).

BedrockInferencePrefix.Description: Bedrock only. auto picks the cross-region inference profile for this region; none uses in-region model ids.

DomainCertificateArn.Description: Set by CoderHelm's stack update once your domain's certificate is issued. Leave empty.

DomainZoneId.Description: Set by CoderHelm's stack update when your domain's zone is in Route 53 here. Leave empty.

EmailFrom.Description: The address CoderHelm sends email from. Empty uses your email (AWS emails it a link to confirm).

EmailTransport.Description: ses: this account's Amazon SES. coderhelm: CoderHelm's mail service (hybrid; CoderHelm sees each recipient's address).

Hostname.Description: Your own domain, e.g. coderhelm.example.com. Empty for a free CloudFront address. CoderHelm requests the certificate; Settings, System shows any DNS records to add and proposes the stack update that moves CoderHelm to it.

KeepDataOnDelete.Description: true: deleting this stack keeps the tables, data buckets, keys, user pool and secret. false: deleting it removes them too (keys after AWS's 7-day minimum).

ModelProvider.Description: bedrock (Claude on Amazon Bedrock in this account, no API key) or anthropic (each team adds its own key). Change it later in Settings, System.

RequireTwoFactor.Description: on makes everyone set up an authenticator app, you included.

SetupToken.Description: A one-time key from the install guide that lets it hand your new GitHub App's keys to this install. Empty to create the GitHub App later.

SignupDomain.Description: Empty: only people you invite. Or an email domain whose people may join.

Stage.ConstraintDescription: lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter, at most 20 (no hyphens: coderhelm-prod-* must never also name another install)
Stage.Description: A short name for this install. Resource names start with coderhelm-<name>. Name the stack coderhelm-<name> too.

StatusId.Description: Lets the install guide show progress (a small public status file with the phase and your URL). Empty for none.

UpdateTimezone.Description: The window's time zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

Properties.Description: CoderHelm: the most any CoderHelm role can do (docs/self-host/security.md)
CoderHelm: applies a reviewed release's stack update when auto-update is on (docs/self-host/security.md)
CoderHelm: the install's custom resources (copies the release, the setup key, cleanup on delete)
CoderHelm: GitHub App keys and the session signing key
